discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B006 (packets 206, 410, 455, 488), Disney Store / shopDisney / DSSH 2019. 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. New: DSSH May surprises (Mother's Day Dumbo, Genie Lamp, Up 10th Paradise Falls + Up 10th), Genie Lamp OE wish pin, Magnificent Pin Trading Event sets (members unnamed / structure held), five Nov acorn pins, Frozen 2 Elsa/Olaf, Little Mermaid surprise Vanessa/Silhouette, Dark Tales Pocahontas, Mouseketeers Pennant gift pin. Endgame members corroborated by DS UK official listing (hold-release proposed, not applied). Marvel 80th (2020), 2019 Mystery (parks), Rey/Kylo jumbo (2024) leads resolved.
